Sets a pixel of a locked buffer. The buffer has to be locked with [LockBuffer](LockBuffer) first and the result shows after [UnlockBuffer](UnlockBuffer).

```blitzbasic
;media gif buffers/writepixelfast.gif 20 10
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Local n = 0
While n < 20
	LockBuffer BackBuffer()
	For y = 0 To 239
		For x = 0 To 319
			Local v = (((x + n * 4) / 40) Mod 2) Xor ((y / 40) Mod 2)
			If v Then WritePixelFast x, y, $FF8000 Else WritePixelFast x, y, $2040A0
		Next
	Next
	UnlockBuffer BackBuffer()
	Flip
	n = n + 1
Wend
```

![WritePixelFast](media/buffers/writepixelfast.gif)
@param x       Horizontal position of the pixel.
@param y       Vertical position of the pixel.
@param argb    The color. Only the lower 24 bits are used; the pixel is always opaque.
@param buffer  The locked buffer to write to. Defaults to the current buffer.
@gap A buffer that is not locked stops the program with an error message. A position outside of the buffer is ignored instead of writing into other memory.
@gap A buffer that [Graphics3D](Graphics3D) made with the depth 30 takes A2R10G10B10, and one with 64 takes ARGB with 8 bits for each. [WritePixelFast64](WritePixelFast64) takes all 64 bits. See [Color depth](Color-Depth).
